usedFor: Sentry tracks errors for developers, and Google Docs receives a readable list through “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Project” in Sentry, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: New projects land in one doc tab, so you keep a plain list of what was added.

watchOut: “New Project” in Sentry is polling and reads a scheduled window, so the doc updates after a check.
